identification: Strapped pack of sawn, square-edged boards, all about 50 mm thick, widths roughly 100-200 mm, lengths about 2.4 m (a few shorter), about 20+ boards, on bearers. Hand-written board: 'Approx .4 m3 cub metre kiln dried Tas blackwood all 50 mm thick'. Rough sawn, surfaces greyed/weathered on top, no visible rot.

viewing_check: Count boards and measure widths/lengths to check 0.4 m3. Plane or scrape a small patch and check end grain for blackwood colour and figure (any fiddleback is a bonus). Check for surface checking, end splits, borer holes, cupping/twist, and that it is dry (light for its size, no damp underneath). Note sapwood proportion.
